method: Categorical soft-label index master at 16x (4096), tone-group version: one-hot mask of every native index blurred at 4x and texel-centred bilinear to 16x; crisp contours everywhere (sigma 0.42 texel, power 4); where the native page dithers between indices that share the class under every renderable static CLUT of the page and are close in colour (RGB distance <= 56) under at least 75 % of them, only those indices are blended (sigma 1.0 texel), so dither becomes the intended mixed tone while edges between distinct tones stay crisp; dither share window 0.3..0.65; top-3 labels kept; texels whose native index lost its own centre keep a rounded-square core of that index (superellipse p=6, full weight to the mid-edges), native index forced at every texel centre. Palette-independent material logD at 8x: relief from the reference-CLUT luminance (sigma 0.9 texel, light from the upper left), groove AO at strong luminance edges, low-amplitude luminance detail synthesised from the stage-4 JuggernautXL sea-base swatches of frozen/s4-swatches-v1 (salt-corroded steel, wet painted steel, faded orange paint, salt/rust streaks; they replace the Stage 1 city/Greif swatches of v1) (raw images where they exist, centre 60%, overlapping Hann-windowed random patches, horizontal flips only: no tiling seam, no repeat; high-pass sigma 48 px, band-limited sigma 1.5 px at 2048 for motion), low-frequency grime; zero-mean per native index, so every native colour keeps its average. Render per CLUT, box-down to 2048/1024, native class stamped at every texel centre. v3 (soft.strokes): 1-texel line runs whose tone changes along the line are rebuilt as continuous strokes: a texel is h-thin (v-thin) when it differs from both vertical (horizontal) neighbours; checkerboard dither (thin both ways with >= 2 equal diagonals) is excluded; runs of >= 3 such texels with >= 2 distinct indices and a calm background on both sides (<= 0.25 index changes per pair within +-3 texels; runs split where it gets busy) become one superellipse capsule (p=6, half-width 0.5 texel, 0.12 texel fade, rounded-square caps); along the run each pixel takes the native index of the texel it lies in, so tones change exactly at native texel boundaries; coverage is resolved globally (highest wins) and blended into the top-3 labels; native index forced at every texel centre afterwards.
render_formula: w = top-3 soft labels; base = sum_k w_k P[l_k] over labels of the dominant class; rgb = base * exp(logD) (opaque classes); class = class(P[l_0]); class 0 = raw black; runtime = majority-class box-down of the 4096 render + native class (and the native colour where the class had to change) stamped at floor((i+0.5)*scale)

class_validation.convention: class at pixel floor((i+0.5)*scale) of every native texel == class(CLUT[native index]); class 0 = raw 0x0000, 255 = STP, 127 = opaque

alpha_channel: categorical PSX classes (0 = raw 0x0000, 127 opaque, 255 STP), NOT opacity; exact at every native texel centre
honest_read: The v2 bead chains are fixed. 1-texel lines whose tone changes along the line are now continuous strokes: the D349E0F6 v185 gradient strips, the E8769E55 orange/grey trims and the 1DE4AA74 row-27 dark line. Tones change exactly at the native texel boundaries, stepped along the line as in the native. Stroke runs per page: 270 / 168 / 148 / 260 / 430 / 273 (E8769E55, 5536C111, E72FB1C1, D349E0F6, 1DE4AA74, 3E287F33), 1.5-3.6k texels = 2-5 % of each page.
Class-exact: 0 centre-class mismatches in 12 exports; the native index is still forced at every texel centre.
Stroke ends are rounded-square caps, and the stroke edge fades over 0.12 texel, so thin lines read very slightly wider and softer-ended than the native pixels.

Motion SIMULATION (bilinear no-mip fly-past, review/motion-sim-v2-v3.*): the gradient strips are more stable than v2 (twinkle 0.035 vs 0.045 at 9 px/texel, 0.18 vs 0.22 at 3 px/texel) and keep native contrast (18.6 vs native 18.8; v2 15.9). The crisper trims and pipes twinkle slightly more than v2 (trims 0.081 vs 0.054, pipes 0.039 vs 0.033 at 3 px/texel), still 3-5x below native nearest (0.276 / 0.159).

Not rebuilt (v2 behaviour kept): lines on busy backgrounds (neighbour rows changing more than 0.25 per texel pair within +-3 texels, e.g. 1DE4AA74 row 27 u98-102 beside a vertical line), runs shorter than 3 texels, diagonal 1-texel lines (axis-aligned runs only) and same-tone lines (already continuous in v2).

Everything else is v2 unchanged: salt-weathered swatch mottle on flat plates, faint vertical run-off on 5536C111 (which looks like unit parts, identity unverified), dither as soft blotches, staircases as rounded steps. Not a realism rebuild.
known_limits: All keys are predicted-static: none has been seen live; the review CLUT is the static CLUT that draws the most of the page, not a proven pairing. Import only after the stage-4 run confirms each key.

One render per page (the review CLUT); the other static predicted keys are listed as renderable_later and render from the same master once captured; palette-hold keys (runtime-written or multi-candidate CLUT positions) wait for AQ-05 phase lists.
Material relief is derived from the review CLUT's luminance; for a CLUT with a different tone order the relief can be inverted in places (zero-mean per index keeps average colours).
Review panel C is a SIMULATION (bilinear from runtime-2048, no mips, 9 px per texel); no in-game capture exists.
Pages 640, 704, 896 and 960 are replaced later in the stage by member 2/22 (different TEX); these masters cover the section-1 versions only.

Swatches are the stage-4 candidates of frozen/s4-swatches-v1 (salt-corroded steel, wet painted steel, faded orange paint, salt/rust streaks), used as luminance detail only. They have not been judged against any live stage-4 surface.
Directional swatch detail (run-off, streaks) assumes texture-space vertical is world vertical; UV orientation is unproven until AQ-03 draw logs.
Strokes are axis-aligned only; the thin-line rule is a heuristic in index space (checkerboard and noisy rows excluded) and can miss or include an occasional short run.
